title: Transport Fever 2
summary: Transport and management simulation built around creating passenger and freight networks by land, water and air. Accessible reviews emphasize logistics depth, network optimization and sandbox/modding longevity, while also noting that the systems and difficulty choices can take time to learn.

observations.statement: Reviews repeatedly value the linked passenger, freight and route-management systems as the core source of strategic depth.
Sandbox, map editing and mod support are repeatedly cited as reasons the simulation stays engaging over long campaigns.
More than one review notes that efficient freight networks and higher difficulty settings require substantial learning and planning.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index sampled without archiving raw review text
